note: 胜利之斗争 战术系

abilities.desc_zh: 每次完美格挡对手近战攻击，必定发动“破剑反击”，打断对手攻击链并造成硬直与流血。
abilities.desc_en: Perfect blocks trigger a Parry Counter, interrupting the opponent combo and causing heavy hitstun and Bleed.

abilities.desc_zh: 近战连击每次命中积累一层“正义之气”（最多 10 层），每层提供 +{{var_1}} 攻击力与破甲。
abilities.desc_en: Melee strikes generate Spirit of Justice stacks (max 10), each granting +{{var_1}} Attack and Armor Piercing.

abilities.desc_zh: 面对格斗系 (Brawler) 或具有霸体/狂暴效果的敌人时，史达洞察其动作，无视对手的不可阻挡 (Unstoppable) 特性并直接将其打断！
abilities.desc_en: Against Brawlers or Unstoppable enemies, Star Saber insights bypass Unstoppable status and interrupt their strikes cleanly.

abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技凝聚正义极光，伤害无视对手一切护甲与力场，并使自身获得最高司令官护盾，吸收 {{var_2}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Special Attacks radiate pure justice energy, ignoring all Armor and Shields, while granting himself a Supreme Commander Barrier absorbing {{var_2}} damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 史达拔剑突进瞬斩，剑光撕裂长空穿透对手并施加流血，在 {{var_1}} 秒内造成 {{var_2}} 伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Draws his blade in a dash slash, piercing through the opponent and dealing {{var_2}} Bleed damage over {{var_1}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 王者之剑斩出十字极光波，削减敌方 {{var_3}} 护甲持续 {{var_4}} 秒，并使目标眩晕 {{var_5}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Unleashes a cross energy wave, reducing enemy Armor by {{var_3}} for {{var_4}}s and stunning for {{var_5}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 王者之剑化作神光从天而降，造成巨额真实伤害，自身获得持续 {{var_6}} 秒的领袖光环，提升 {{var_7}} 攻击力与护甲。
abilities.desc_en: The cosmic blade descends from the heavens, granting himself a Supreme Commander buff increasing Attack and Armor by {{var_7}} for {{var_6}}s.

abilities.desc_zh: 与擎天柱、补天士、通天晓同队时，全队获得 +{{var_2}} 攻击力与护甲。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Attack and Armor for all Autobot Leaders.

abilities.desc_zh: 与漂移、雷震同队或对战时，获得 +{{var_3}} 暴击伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_3}} Critical Damage when paired with or against Drift or Bludgeon.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_4}} 能量获取速率。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_4}} Power Rate.
